overall.summary: Every claim and prose number reproduces and no sentence is refuted (the one recheck direction mismatch is a false positive). Weakened: the root's plain text calls the parts non-additive, blames the flat start of the calls effect on the floor and hides the steep rise above 3 calls; three part hypotheses leave out a main input (voice-mail plan in the usage terms, evening charge in the calls-vs-evening part, the West Virginia exception of the gate); two 'from about 1% to about 1%' sentences; 'patients' in a churn text.
